orientation.convention: Three.js rotation about +Y; model U points east-northeast; local output X east, Z south
orientation.method: Convex hull edge scan for the minimum-area rectangle of the original WGS84 polygon projected to local metres; choose the long axis with east-positive U.

model.coordinateSystem: Local metres centred on centroid; X east, Y up, Z south
model.placementBasis: OSM footprint centroid and long-axis orientation; model dimensions retain the existing authored artwork
model.geometryBasis: All podiums, storeys, rooflines, timber galleries, columns, windows and stairs are an artistic approximation, not a surveyed or photogrammetric reconstruction. The sourced footprint anchors the model; it does not certify the authored silhouette or per-part dimensions.
model.groundBasis: The original prototype terrain offset is removed. All geometry is rebased to model ground zero; the map layer chooses the anchor elevation independently.
model.heightBasis: Authored artistic geometry; no random or inferred OSM height is used
model.scope: Hongyadong artwork only; excludes terrain, roads, ordinary city buildings, bridge, boats and trees
model.optimizations: Eight material batches, reused primitive templates, lower roof mesh and tile seam sampling, fewer awning/rail segments; retains the original curved eaves, stepped wings and timber palette

renderReplacement.basis: The bundled Protomaps z15 building at the centroid matches the source OSM footprint with tile quantization and simplification. Lower source zooms merge buildings and do not retain this ID; show the model only above map zoom 15.2. Suppress this exact feature ID only while the authored model renders; restore the original filter in 2D, street detail, low zoom or model failure. Revalidate the ID when replacing the city archive.

groundFit.anchorPolicy: Highest river-front sample minus the authored 9.6m entry platform, plus 0.65m visual clearance. Extend only original stone bottom vertices down to the DEM minus 0.4m; do not cut terrain, move XY, raise roof vertices locally or infer surveyed building elevation.
groundFit.flatPolicy: Anchor 0m and restore original stone vertices exactly. Platform heights and clearance remain authored art, not measured storeys or entrances.
